title: VanhDesign WebGPU single-scene page driven by Blender keyboard model
summary: VanhDesign template uses one WebGPU-rendered 3D scene to drive an entire landing page from a single HTML file, with a Blender command-line keyboard model sharing wireframe and finished geometry.
question_it_answers: How can one WebGPU 3D scene drive a whole landing page without Three.js?

claims.text: Template is one HTML file about 201 KB plus the model, WebGPU rendered, no Three.js and no manual steps.
claims.evidence: One HTML file, 201 KB + the model, no ThreeJs, no manual steps, simple prompts to fix.
claims.subject: web-3d-scenes

claims.text: Keyboard geometry is modeled in Blender from the command line and rendered in WebGPU so wireframe and finished views share the same mesh.
claims.evidence: The keyboard is modelled in Blender from a command line and rendered with WebGPU, so the wireframe you see on the left is the same geometry as the finished aluminium on the right.
claims.subject: image-to-3d-world
